_comment: Single source of truth for the on-disk dataset layout. Consumed by tools/verify_setup.py and tests/test_project_setup.m so the Python tooling and the MATLAB pipeline cannot drift apart. Paths are relative to the data root (see config/drishti_paths.m). Counts were verified 2026-09-11 and cross-checked against the published dataset specifications.

directories.note: MIXED formats: 1058 .png + 690 .JPG (uppercase) - different acquisition batches. Glob case-insensitively and expect JPEG artifacts in ~40% of the set.

files.note: Krause et al. adjudicated reference standard: image_id, adjudicated_dr_grade (0-4), adjudicated_dme (0/1), adjudicated_gradable (0/1). 1748 rows, 4 ungradable. NOTE: referable prevalence 26.2% here vs 14.6% in Gulshan 2016 on the same images - different reference standard, see docs/datasets.md.
